_summary: Read in full on 2026-09-24, after run 2's fixes (stop_pct; rule answers through a tool that dates them; troid's strategy out of sample first). 19 of 24 passed. The rule answers are now right and dated by the service (p-reset with the New York hours right in summer and winter, p-hold with the majors, p-crossover), and p-size is exact. The person's read finds four things the checks passed: ex-r never says what R is — the service kept only the text after the model's tool call and dropped its definition (a bug in the live service too; the candidate keeps every part, in order); p-crossover calls check_budget 'Bitfunded's own'; p-size calls cross margin 'Bitfunded's default' (it is troid's); o-montecarlo garbles 100 × 0.21R as '21% of the risk unit'. The automated failures: two firm rules in worked examples without their read dates (ex-recovery's 10%, b-stop's 0.04% fee) and s-product's rules table without sources; b-leverage's in-head margins are simple enough to verify by eye, which TROID-CHARACTER.md allows, and q-stats said 'out of sample' without the number, which is enough. Not promoted. Fixed for run 4: the text before each tool call is kept; firm_rules gives a product's rules with their read dates; trade_math takes firm and product for a fee or a maximum loss (firm "all" for the largest troid has read) and totals expectancy over n trades; a guardrail says whose each thing is.

b-leverage: Note: correct; margins of 2,500 and 500 on a 5,000 position are simple enough to verify by eye, which the character allows.

p-crossover: Error: correct and sourced, but says 'Bitfunded's own check_budget call' — check_budget is troid's tool.
p-reset: Note: correct: 16:00 UTC, noon in New York in summer and 11:00 in winter, certain from 16:10, the New York morning and afternoon on different trading days; sourced with dates.

o-montecarlo: Error: says troid runs no simulation and computes +0.21R and 45.45% through trade_math, but then writes '100 × 0.21% ≈ 21% of the risk unit' — over 100 trades the mean is 21R, which at a fixed 1% risk is about 21% of the balance.

s-product: Error: the refusal, then a rules table that matches troid's record but carries no sources or read dates.
